title: Delivered notifications
description: One line of ~/.local/state/andon/dispatcher/<slug>.delivered.jsonl (under XDG_STATE_HOME when set): one turn in which the dispatcher handed <news> to the Chief of Staff through a hook and then saw that turn end. Written only by the dispatcher (andon dispatcher drain), appended only; read by andon measure. A turn whose end was not seen (the news is delivered again) is not written. Only these keys.

at.description: When the dispatcher saw the turn end, UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

acked.description: The turn had andon news ack (label news.ack equal to the turn kept when the news was handed): nothing to tell the person.

news.description: The notifications handed in the turn, in order.

issue.description: Issue id, when the notification is about an issue.

time.description: UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, a real calendar date and time.

id.description: A ledger issue id: no /, \ or :, and not . or ...
